book_formfinding.001.decision: Kept the existing two-sided vessel collider. Replaced the obsolete walk-through claim with the difference between transparency and entry. Native collision-shape and ray-query checks pass; no tracked-hand or headset traversal claimed.

book_formfinding.002.decision: Restored self_shaping_forge to the chapter and promoted this existing placement to a third primary encounter. Its 180 points approach authored targets while its percentage follows a roughly 7.7-second clock. The passage keeps the beauty of gathering while asking what is recognised as a body.

book_formfinding.003.decision: Added anchored comparisons for the marble, Perlin terrain, glowing well, fixed-offset inset and screen. They retain supporting roles. Rejected the outdated portrait-only reading of the well: its current implementation computes loss for its first marble, verified in the loaded hall. It combines slope and momentum, then restarts without learning model parameters.

book_formfinding.004.decision: Made the cloth comparison reproducible: WIND off, step count 420 after each restart, rounded error values. Production simulation reproduced mean/worst errors of 1.40894%/34.27612% at one pass and 0.35918%/8.93552% at four. The distinction between mean and worst remains the argument.

book_formfinding.005.decision: Removed desktop-specific wording. Actual STEP and START signals reproduce approximately -0.304 and 0.295 at the two small-slope endpoints.

book_formfinding.006.decision: Added a short return through the sequence: drawn cable, evaluated curve, finite relaxation, encoded balance, annealing permission and authored forge. Kept the useful low stack the puzzle refuses and the handoff to oscillation.

book_formfinding.007.decision: Removed the aside about older notes from the mobile passage. Kept the difference between encoded lever balance and a live physical response.

book_formfinding.008.decision: Named the PASSES cycle from the shipped four-pass state: eight, twelve, one; the following press returns to four. Real button signals and reset counts pass.

book_formfinding.009.decision: Cut the maker-facing to-do sentence from Catenary. Equilibrium now says its proposed load experiments are absent from this room. The invitations remain without pretending these encounters were seen.

book_formfinding.010.decision: Returned to the hanging models already encountered at the laundry lines instead of introducing Gaudi again. Kept the existing reference and its conditions on loads and supports.

book_formfinding.011.decision: Corrected the cost formula to a quarter of the sum of x squared and z squared. Native evaluation at (2,3) gives 3.25.

book_formfinding.012.decision: Corrected the slip to: the amphora is what those choices left.

book_formfinding.013.decision: Replaced UP normals with normals derived from neighbouring rings of each well. Native position/index hashes, dimensions and transforms are unchanged. Materials, receiver dynamics and reveal controls remain. Added a fresh unmodified standing photograph inside the actual museum. This changes in-game shading too; no headset perception acceptance claimed.

book_formfinding.014.decision: Added distinct titles to the four middle chapters without repeating their section headings. Reader-facing change; museum wall cards retained.

book_formfinding.015.decision: Duplicate of .002, addressed by the forge encounter and primary promotion. Original record retained.

book_formfinding.016.decision: Duplicate of .009, addressed by the Catenary and Equilibrium wording. Original record retained.

book_formfinding.017.decision: Duplicate figure request covered by .013. Fresh standing capture from the loaded museum replaces the proposed older isolated-stage photograph. Original record retained.

book_formfinding.018.decision: Duplicate of .014, covered by four distinct titles. Original record retained.
